chapters.title: Prologue
chapters.mood: A black storm kills the city’s lights, and someone watches from inside it.

chapters.title: First Place
chapters.dateline: Selrick Academy, Terrinia. Fourteen years later.
chapters.mood: A transfer student breaks a record on her first day, and the girl she beat starts racing her at everything.

chapters.title: After Midnight
chapters.dateline: Selrick Academy, the night of Fanny’s first day.
chapters.mood: Second place for the first time. Layla works in secret through the night, then races Fanny for drones.

chapters.title: Weak Spots
chapters.mood: A lesson on where Enders break, a drill that goes wrong, and then the siren.

chapters.title: The Northeastern Sector
chapters.mood: The dome is torn, a teacher falls, and two rivals have to fight side by side.

chapters.title: Cover Me
chapters.mood: A gold giant through the dome, a reckless jump, and one shot that has to land.

chapters.title: All Rested Up?
chapters.dateline: A ruined rooftop, the same night.
chapters.mood: Night on a broken roof. Two rivals, too tired to fight, finally say what they mean.

chapters.title: Secret Base
chapters.mood: Five days into the rebuilding, Layla unlocks a door at midnight and shows Fanny what she has been hiding.

chapters.title: My Teammate
chapters.mood: Two rivals made one team, a contest over chocolate, and a gift with a teal ribbon.

chapters.title: The Heir
chapters.dateline: Planet Oro, in another galaxy. Years before the dome broke.
chapters.mood: On Planet Oro the heir may have no friends and no feelings. So she builds herself a way out.

chapters.title: What Does Hurt Mean?
chapters.dateline: Planet Oro, the Laboratory and the Gardens.
chapters.mood: An android who has never seen the sun steps into a secret garden and makes her first friend.

chapters.title: The Long-Awaited Moment
chapters.mood: The Council has voted. Ruby finally makes her move, and says goodbye to the only friend she has.

chapters.title: Rioters
chapters.mood: Angela is sent to save the Rioters. From far away, Ruby watches what the order really means.

chapters.title: Angela, Stop!
chapters.mood: Ruby lands in a burning city and finds Angela fighting for Oro. She will not let her go.

chapters.title: Ruby!
chapters.mood: Angela wakes in a burning street, and only she can stop what Ruby is about to do.

chapters.title: All Normal
chapters.mood: Locked in a cell with no window, Ruby tells Angela the truth. Somewhere above them, her father is watching.

chapters.title: Newcomers
chapters.dateline: Selrick Academy, days after the ship landed.
chapters.mood: A black ship lands at the city’s edge, and two armed girls walk down the ramp asking for refuge.

chapters.title: A New Product from R&D
chapters.dateline: The Science Division. The week the newcomers came.
chapters.mood: The youngest Chief Scientist in Terrinia mends everyone’s machines. She wants one thing more, and Lesley says no.

chapters.title: The House
chapters.mood: Lesley wakes from an old dream, and the ache behind her visor takes her back to the house where she grew up.

chapters.title: An Unknown Corner of the World
chapters.mood: A girl stows away to a far fort, where Enders walk out of the grass, and teaches herself to wait.

chapters.title: Sis
chapters.mood: A child who acts like a grown-up builds herself a friend. Then a new guard comes to the base.

chapters.title: Happy Birthday, Lesley!
chapters.mood: Chang’e finds out that Lesley has no birthday, and decides to build her something.

chapters.title: The Best Sniper Ever
chapters.dateline: The research base. A year later.
chapters.mood: Behind a wall of crates marked NO SIS, Chang’e builds Lesley a birthday present all by herself.

chapters.title: A Core Component
chapters.mood: Lesley brings home a piece of an Ender, whole. In Chang’e’s hands it starts to glow.

chapters.title: The First Light
chapters.dateline: The research base. The evening of the first light.
chapters.mood: The frame in the lab finally holds its light, and nobody wants to go to bed.

chapters.title: It’s a Decoy
chapters.dateline: Terrinia. The night the base fell.
chapters.mood: Lesley rides home to find the city’s edge on fire. From a rooftop she sees where the giant is walking.

chapters.title: A Very Long Time
chapters.mood: The night the base fell, Chang’e writes a letter she never sends. Across the water, Lesley keeps watch for years.

chapters.title: Over Here, Ender!
chapters.dateline: Terrinia. Years after the base fell.
chapters.mood: The Enders come back, and Chang’e stands alone in front of a shelter door. Across the water, one window is lit.

chapters.title: Selrick
chapters.mood: At dawn Chang’e takes hold of a coat. Weeks later, on the ruins of the base, two of them start a school.

chapters.title: Great Job, Guys!
chapters.dateline: The Science Division. The next morning.
chapters.mood: Checks in the lab, a race down the stairs, a mop race in the hall, and a warm word from the door.

chapters.title: Where Were You?
chapters.mood: One question, years late, asked in a plain room at night. The next day, the hall under five stars.

chapters.title: Light of Day
chapters.dateline: Selrick Academy, the hall. The day the newcomers became Aspirants.
chapters.mood: A fish market under a torn dome, a great lady who will not land early, and someone quietly counting the seconds.

chapters.title: A Lady’s Refinement
chapters.mood: A girl in a great house learns to count to three, and to wait outside a closed door.

chapters.title: Stay Back
chapters.dateline: The night of the fish-market raid.
chapters.mood: A bent drone under a lamp, an old soldier’s screwdriver, and the two words her father always said.

chapters.title: The Top Score
chapters.dateline: Selrick Academy. The first entrance assessment.
chapters.mood: One needle, one year of split knuckles, and a seat in the stand that stays empty.

chapters.title: The Office Door
chapters.dateline: House Baroque. The day after the final trial.
chapters.mood: A paper with two red words on it, a bench outside a half-open door, and a whole day of waiting.

chapters.title: You Are Strong
chapters.mood: Team-Up Day, a gap three meters wide around one girl, and one quiet voice from the shade.

chapters.title: Stay With Me
chapters.mood: A side street at the dome’s foot, a white-gloved hand, and a third question asked in the dark.

chapters.title: Go to Bed
chapters.dateline: Selrick Academy. The first weeks as partners.
chapters.mood: Plans in three colors of ink, a phone call at two in the morning, and a front held alone for two minutes.

chapters.title: Made ’Em Myself
chapters.dateline: The city. The day after the team test.
chapters.mood: A day of shopping that goes wrong, a night of burned fingers, and two small stars on a sunny roof.

chapters.title: Fireworks
chapters.mood: Eleven cakes, a teacup that spins, a box nobody knows about, and a curfew broken for the summer fireworks.

chapters.title: Best Partners
chapters.dateline: Selrick Academy. The end of that year.
chapters.mood: An empty chair, two small blue badges, a photo taken three times, and a lesson about who sends the Enders.

chapters.title: Find a Way
chapters.dateline: The Academy lawn. The same day.
chapters.mood: A head in her lap under a yellowing tree, one sentence about her father, and a paper nobody else has read.

chapters.title: Plan B
chapters.dateline: The morning after the fish-market raid.
chapters.mood: A drone back on its charger, a nap in class, and a plan for coming home, said on a roof just in case.

chapters.title: All by Yourself
chapters.mood: A cut kept secret, a match fought with one arm, a new rule between partners, and two felt dolls finished at last.

chapters.title: Careful, Guinevere
chapters.dateline: The first morning of the watch.
chapters.mood: One ordinary morning, one week of watch duty, and a corridor of tall windows where everything changes.

chapters.title: Missing
chapters.mood: A name on a board, a phone that does not ring, a room never entered before, and a bow nobody straightens.

chapters.title: I Will Find Her
chapters.mood: A map full of red crosses, a telescope at night, a gate she will not pass back through, and a window left lit.

chapters.title: Even on Starless Nights
chapters.mood: Torn into the dark behind the world, Vexana falls, and the star at her collar will not go out.

chapters.title: Vexana of the Aspirants
chapters.mood: Torn from her happiest memory, Vexana is shown a future, and makes a choice she will tell no one.

chapters.title: The Way Home
chapters.mood: The way home stands open. Vexana looks at one lit window for a long time.

chapters.title: For a Price
chapters.mood: The first weeks, alone. Then Vexana needs something only one classmate sells, and Selena names her price.

chapters.title: The Hour of the Call
chapters.mood: At the hour she used to call, Vexana watches one lit window across the city.

chapters.title: The Hollow
chapters.mood: Night after night in the dark, Vexana fits salvaged plates together, until something stands up.

chapters.title: The Matrix Is Transmitting
chapters.dateline: The void, behind Dawnbreak’s sky. The same hour.
chapters.mood: Far out in the dark a great ship arrives, and Obsidia remembers the long watch that brought her here.

chapters.title: That’s Enough Recalibration
chapters.mood: Summoned to the vast body in the dark, Vexana meets the only other mind in the void.

chapters.title: How Many Times
chapters.mood: Aboard the enemy’s ship, Vexana asks its commander for answers, and gets more than she came for.

chapters.title: I Am the Storm
chapters.mood: At the edge of the widening crack, Obsidia shows Vexana a broken suit and the storm she rides.

chapters.title: The Cradle of the Void
chapters.mood: Obsidia finds the one place Vexana thought was hers, then leads her to where the Enders are made.

chapters.title: The Scent of Mud
chapters.mood: Rain over the Academy, a red alert with no sender, and a name nobody gave her. Selena chose it herself.

chapters.title: A Game of Pretend
chapters.mood: Selena copies smiles, mends radios and never cries. One night in a raid she finds out why she is different.

chapters.title: Cold Mecha
chapters.mood: A mended servo, a stall at the city’s edge, and a small director who wants to watch Selena work.

chapters.title: Silverbolt
chapters.mood: A gray training frame, a year of salvage and one storm night: how Selena built the machine only she can ride.

chapters.title: The Red Alert
chapters.mood: A red message, a pull in every cell, and a trade Selena is sure she controls.

chapters.title: Lost Things Turn Up
chapters.dateline: The bell tower. The last week.
chapters.mood: On the bell tower at night, Selena counts what she has seen this year and keeps every secret.

chapters.title: The Huntress
chapters.mood: The pull has a direction now. Selena hunts it, faces a dark window, and leaves Karina’s door at dawn.

chapters.title: The Final Stage
chapters.dateline: The Storm Citadel, the throne hall. The day before.
chapters.mood: The day before, Obsidia sits alone in her throne hall and goes over every move she has planned.

chapters.title: The End Is Drawing Near
chapters.mood: The night before, Vexana keeps watch from a ruined tower over one lit window.

chapters.title: Vexana: Absent
chapters.dateline: Selrick Academy, the observation lab. Before dawn.
chapters.mood: Before dawn a far star over the bay begins to flash, and so does the small gold star at Guinevere’s collar.

chapters.title: The Sky Opens
chapters.mood: The sky over the bay tears open, Enders pour into the city, and one post on the channel never answers.

chapters.title: Rescue Operation
chapters.dateline: A rooftop over the Academy district.
chapters.mood: A small gold star beeps for the first time in weeks, and Guinevere flies off alone to follow it.

chapters.title: Connection Lost
chapters.dateline: The city platforms, above the bay.
chapters.mood: Alone on the city platforms, Guinevere fights her way toward the one person she has been searching for.

chapters.title: Purge Protocol
chapters.mood: Something vast comes through the sky over the bay, and Guinevere spends everything she has left.

chapters.title: I Will Bear It All
chapters.dateline: A street west of the platforms.
chapters.mood: Hurt and alone in a ring of enemies, she says she will bear it all, and means every word.

chapters.title: Pursue Your Light
chapters.dateline: A street west of the platforms.
chapters.mood: Guinevere wakes in a street she never fell into, while Angela holds a bell of pink light against the dark.

chapters.title: Think Again
chapters.mood: A light comes down between the blast and its target, and two old partners face what they kept hidden.

chapters.title: Two Crossing Stars
chapters.mood: Two lights climb toward the chest of something vast, crossing and crossing again like fireworks.

chapters.title: Can You Hear Me?
chapters.mood: In a dark with no up and no down, two voices finally say what they kept hidden.

chapters.title: The Frontline
chapters.mood: The frontline waits at the rail, counting, for anything to come back out of the dark.

chapters.title: Finally, the Fun Part Begins
chapters.dateline: The Storm Citadel, behind the gateway.
chapters.mood: Behind the torn sky something vast wakes, and on the bell tower a girl with a lollipop starts to smile.

chapters.title: Shall We Begin?
chapters.mood: The frontline fights as one at last, until the storm over the Academy comes down.

chapters.title: Hold Fire
chapters.mood: A gray shape climbs the tower toward the console, and Lesley has to wait for Chang’e’s word.

chapters.title: This So-Called Destiny
chapters.mood: High on the bell tower, the girl with the lollipop finally makes up her mind.

chapters.title: Take a Good Look
chapters.dateline: The bay road cut, below the Academy.
chapters.mood: On the wet stones of the cut, Guinevere looks up at someone she thought she knew.

chapters.title: Back to Back
chapters.mood: One narrow street, a wall of doors and shop signs, and a frontline that holds together.

chapters.title: The Scenic Route
chapters.mood: On the bell tower a girl bites her lollipop and takes the scenic route up into the storm.

chapters.title: Since When Were We Resting?
chapters.mood: The power comes back to the street all at once, and nobody has time to rest.

chapters.title: Give Me Back My Freedom
chapters.dateline: Inside the Storm Citadel, before it fell.
chapters.mood: High above the storm, a maker calls her creation home, and gets her answer.
